results.title: A Pseudo-Feminist
results.overview: College student Wang Qi returns to his hometown and meets a girl named Tian Ning. As winter vacation passes, everything develops in a direction Wang Qi could never have imagined...

results.title: Maidenhair
results.overview: An awkward teen develops a crush on a salesman visiting her father's parish.

results.title: Me Rompiste el Corazón
results.overview: It tells the story of Roberto Parra Sandoval, creator of the cueca chora and chronicler of Buenos Aires' bohemian scene. A guide boy and stowaway on freight trains, he forges a life in the brothels and bars of Valparaíso and Santiago, bringing the music of the working-class neighborhoods to life. His world changes radically when he meets Negra Ester, a fascinating and contradictory woman who plunges him into a passionate and heartbreaking love. Together they will experience a story that beats to the rhythm of the cueca brava, amid laughter, hurt, and disappointment, in the heart of a marginal, luminous, and painful Chile.

results.title: A Must-see Movie Before You Die
results.overview: Kino, his wife Via, and their best friend Wahyu celebrate one million subscribers on their YouTube channel by reviewing ‘Must-See Movies Before You Die,’ unaware it will be their last video together. Now, Kino sits alone, haunted by memories and wrestling with overwhelming despair, desperately trying to find hope.

results.title: Unsavable
results.overview: Mauro has arranged to have dinner at a luxurious restaurant with Angel, the stranger whose life he saved a few weeks ago.

results.title: The Thing in the Fog
results.overview: During a routine flight, a veteran pilot and his enigmatic trainee co-pilot must face an interdimensional alien invasion that threatens to destroy all of humanity.

results.title: ROH Final Battle 2025 - Zero Hour
results.overview: Ring of Honor Final Battle Zero Hour Pre Show | 12/5/25 Columbus, Ohio

results.title: The Beginning
results.overview: Seeking refuge from a broken marriage, Pilar returns to her childhood home by the sea, only to find it buried beneath shifting dunes. Amid the ruins, she meets Luis and Miguel, two strangers whose paths intertwine with hers. Together, they embark on a transformative journey, uncovering the meaning of love, loss, and the resilience to shape their futures.

results.title: A Good Child
results.overview: Follows Jia Hao, a drag queen, who returns home to care for his mother with dementia, leading to healing and self-discovery through deception.

results.title: Damon Sumner: I'm A Professional
results.overview: In his debut special, Damon Sumner hilariously dives into his inability to maintain a social life, raising both his kids and those of others and maintaining friendships as a couple at The Limelight Theater in Atlanta, GA.

results.title: Patchwork with Grandpa and Grandma
results.overview: The director’s grandparents, who have been together for over 60 years, recall (and re-edit) fragments of their life together. The film, originally intended as part of a video installation, captures a return to a nonlinear past, while also probing how textures and the materiality of images can be inscribed onto the cinema screen.

results.title: The Alien Next Door
results.overview: One night, an unidentified object suddenly appeared in the garden of a broken apartment in downtown where the whispers of love next door resounded every night, and a naked man (Shohei Uno) who called himself an "alien" came out of it. It is said that he made an untimely landing due to the failure of the spaceship, and he lives in an apartment.

results.title: Skillhouse
results.overview: Ten influencers are lured into a sinister content house and forced to compete in lethal social media challenges — because in Skillhouse, clout isn’t just currency, it’s survival.

results.title: The Goodman
results.overview: After a disastrous money transport, in which three tons of product were delivered but the cash never returned, chaos erupts within the cartel. The boss is dead - murdered by someone from within. Cleo, the cartel's fixer, takes charge of the internal investigation.

results.title: "L'Opera Seria" @ Teatro alla Scala Milan
results.overview: In search of an opera for his theatre, an impresario finds himself grappling with a group of egotists and jealous individuals. Based on a score by Florian Leopold Gassmann, this caustic satire of the 18th-century opera world is directed by Laurent Pelly. Starring Julie Fuchs as the prima donna.

results.title: Sergey Orlov: Stand-Up All Day
results.original_title: Сергей Орлов: Стенд ап целый день
results.overview: With his characteristic energy and absurdist humor, Sergey Orlov examines everyday absurdities—from awkward sugar sticks in cafes to barbershop visits and belief in aliens.

results.title: Fabrizio Copano: From the Future
results.overview: In his first English-language special, Chilean comedian Fabrizio Copano delivers sharp, fast-paced stand-up about identity, fatherhood, and cultural whiplash. Taped just before becoming a U.S. citizen, From The Future captures the moment when one joke about the president made him so paranoid, he actually applied for citizenship. It's a hilarious ride through the immigrant experience, millennial parenting, and the absurdity of living between two cultures-all told with heart, anxiety, and a slightly panicked smile.

results.title: Popemobile
results.overview: To mark his recent appointment, the new Pope prepares for a tour of Latin America, only to find that the Vatican is bankrupt. A rich Mexican woman offers to help out. In return for financing his trip, she demands he attends an event in his honour in the city of Ciudad Juarez – Mexico’s capital of crime. The “guardian angel” turns out to be a drug trafficker, and when she discovers that a lookalike Pope has been sent in his place, confusion, laughter and unexpected chaos ensue.

results.title: A Lonely Person's Monologue
results.overview: “A Lonely Person’s Monologue” is a classic father-son story. The author enriches it with additional details and meanings, taking it beyond the frame of domestic drama and placing the complex father-son relationship in the context of war.
